channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 26 Nov 2026
item.description:
Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after US export rules: Nvidia has told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The move follows new US export controls aimed at Chinese cloud access, and dealers are reportedly seeking buyers for thousands of B300 chips.
.NET 11 makes CoreCLR the default MAUI runtime and adds incremental XAML hot reload: Microsoft's .NET 11 release includes a MAUI update focused on quality. CoreCLR is now the default runtime on all platforms, and XAML gets incremental hot reload and faster resource dictionaries.
1Password says intruder reached its source code and customer data: An intruder planted malicious code in 1Password's backend services and obtained source code and customer data. The company says user passwords are safe.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban AI-generated music from December 9 and remove millions of tracks: Tidal will stop allowing fully AI-generated music on December 9 and will delete roughly 29 million such songs. It expects to reject about 80,000 to 85,000 tracks a day, and it will still accept AI-assisted work.
Java4Shell: Patch fix for HotSpot Base64 decoder memory corruption flaw (CVE-2026-114938): Oracle and the OpenJDK project released fixes on November 17 for CVE-2026-114938, a memory corruption bug in the HotSpot JVM's Base64 decoder, reported by researcher Calif. JetBrains is urging users to update its IDEs and related tools.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook outage: Microsoft has declared an unusual internal 'Code Red' after an Exchange Online and Outlook outage that took down email for millions of customers for nearly a day. A bug on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers triggered it.
